items.title: Storefront returns 502
items.summary: Users see 502 Bad Gateway after an application change. Find why the proxy cannot reach the application and restore checkout without taking the proxy down.

items.title: Checkout API unreachable after migration
items.summary: The storefront loads, but every checkout fails after the API moved to a new address. Find where the old address survives and recover without taking the site offline.

items.title: Checkout slows to a halt
items.summary: Checkout latency climbs until requests time out, and the database is close to its connection limit. Find the cause before the obvious fix breaks something else.

items.title: Raise connection pool limits
items.summary: A performance fix raises pool and worker limits after a checkout slowdown. Decide whether the change is safe for the shared database.
